# Data Directory

This directory contains the SQLite database for the Manga Tracker application.

## Files (Auto-generated)

- `manga-tracker.db` - Main SQLite database
- `manga-tracker.db-shm` - Shared memory file (WAL mode)
- `manga-tracker.db-wal` - Write-ahead log file (WAL mode)

## Note

These files are automatically created when you first run the application. They are gitignored to prevent committing local data to the repository.

Each deployment will start with a fresh database.
